blocks.title: 1. What is Division? Fair Sharing
blocks.content: Division means **sharing a quantity equally** among groups or friends. When we share, everyone receives the exact same amount. If everyone has equal candies, all friends are happy!

blocks.title: 2. Sharing One-by-One
blocks.content: To share fairly, give **one object at a time** in rounds. Once everyone receives one, start the next round until the jar is empty or not enough items remain to give one to each person.

blocks.title: 3. What is a Remainder? Leftovers
blocks.content: Sometimes objects cannot be divided equally without breaking them. The items left over in the container are called the **remainder**. Having leftovers is completely natural in sharing!

blocks.title: 4. The Division Equation
blocks.content:
Every sharing activity builds a mathematical sentence:

**Total = (Friends × Share per Friend) + Leftovers**

For example: **10 = 3 × 3 + 1**

blocks.title: 5. Formal Mathematical Terms
blocks.content:
• **Dividend:** The total quantity you start with (candies in the jar).
• **Divisor:** The number of equal groups or friends receiving shares.
• **Quotient:** The amount each friend gets.
• **Remainder:** The leftover quantity that cannot be shared equally.
